_spec.purpose: The variety engine. No two decks visually alike.
_spec.why: Each run records the techniques, palette, structure and camera it used, and the next run reads this to know what it may not reach for again. Without it a machine converges on whatever worked once, which is how a daily product develops a house style nobody chose.
_spec.enforced_by: scripts/carousel/bespoke_check.py measures WITHIN a deck. This ledger constrains ACROSS decks. Both are needed: a deck can be nine different drawings that all look like last Tuesday.

entries.camera: one tilted sheet, then a flat rule, then straight down on a bed, then a lit table, then a flat sheet, then straight on at four courses, then a block on stone, then one lit cell
entries.cut: Slide 4, whose water and whose power, was cut after scoring. Its headline promised power and the frame delivered only water, and it sat before the deck's densest frame. The freed frame went to the close, which had no way for a reader to act.
entries.renumbered_after_the_cut: Recorded at the third scoring pass. The register, three palette notes and the camera line were all written against the nine slide plan and survived the cut of slide 4 unchanged, so this entry named the wrong frame for the paper inversion, for both accent fills and in every camera move after the fourth. Nothing checked it, because the variety ledgers are written at ship and no gate reads them back against the deck.
entries.bespoke_measurement_note: 0.5314 was this deck's first measurement and it was wrong about the deck, not about the gate's arithmetic. bespoke_check was still counting the standing masthead, which this run put on every frame: on the closest pair it shared 50 tokens and exactly one was a drawing call. The gate now strips anything carrying a tx- class. RE-MEASURED under the corrected gate, the two earlier decks move only 0.3997 to 0.4061 and 0.2298 to 0.2300, because neither carried that masthead. Their own entries keep the figures they shipped with, which is what those runs were judged on.
entries.rebuilt_at_the_ninth_pass: Three techniques in this list named frames that were replaced during scoring and were caught by two judges reading the ledger against the renders. Slide 7 was recorded as a redaction field of struck bars, which is a drawing nobody made: two judges read the struck bars as an assertion that something had been struck out, which c17 does not support, and it was rebuilt as the survey title block its own dossier had asked for. Slide 3 was recorded as a flat field of identical cells and was rebuilt under one raking key, because a flat frame reads as an unfinished render and its own risks list said so. Slide 6 ran its courses DOWN, which forced four display words to 90 degrees under four near-black plates, and now runs them across. The ledger is the next run's only memory of what not to reuse, so a technique recorded here that never shipped blocks tomorrow from a drawing nobody made and leaves the drawing that ran unrecorded. This entry is now written against the renders rather than against the plan.

entries.written_from: render/render_report.json and the gates' own output, never from the storyboard. The 2026-08-19 entry recorded a technique that never shipped and wrote down why that is corrosive, and the very next run did it again on the frame it had cut. An entry written while the deck is still moving describes a deck that did not ship.

entries.red_note: Spent once, on the closing frame, on the label, the date and the hour of the League City council's next meeting ("NEXT COUNCIL MEETING"), with a solid rule beneath so the focal is an area. November 3rd is DENIED the red on every frame it appears on, because a nonbinding election is not a deadline and the deck's argument is that the date which looks like the decision is not the one. Measured 5.12 to 1 on the stock and 2.89 on the dark ground, which is why only a paper frame could carry it.
entries.camera: one centimetre off the paper, backing away one readable step per frame, flat copy stand at 2 and 3, the table tilts once at 4 and holds through 5, plan view over an almost empty card at 6, square to the foot of the ballot at 7
entries.bespoke_closest_pair: slide-06.html and slide-07.html at 0.7412, the two pale typographic frames the deck ends on
entries.cut: TWO frames were cut, both by scoring panels rather than by the showrunner. The duration-as-extent inversion went after panel one, where all three judges called it slide 5's argument made twice in a weaker drawing and its own dossier had named the bar chart risk that landed. The county map went after panel two, which found it asserting a county membership no claim supports and a universal negative that is probably wrong. NO CARTOGRAPHY SHIPPED and no county is named anywhere in this deck.
structural_laws: every mark is either printed or added, never both, and a press artifact is a third thing. Slide 2's second impression of the opening clause is letterforms and is nobody's line to read, declared aria-hidden and decorative at a measured 1.47 to 1

the two GROUNDS never mix, and lit paper is not a ground. A frame stands on stock or on houston_black and never both. Stock VALUE appears on three of the dark frames, on the charter's lit course, the ballot card and the bounded figure, because paper under the deck's one lamp reads as paper wherever it lies. The law as first written said stock never crosses at all, and the fourth panel was right that the renders had already contradicted it
the palette is craft and never evidence, so no frame names a soil
an oval is never furniture, and it is empty or filled, never partly
the perforation never tears, because the election has not happened
the stock is new, no stains, no yellowing, no deckle
no numeral appears that is not in claims.json, and no county and no distance appears at all
fourth_panel_repairs: November 3rd, 2026 is now printed on frames 3, 4 and 7. Seven slides about a referendum named the election on none of them, and the caption is the only place it appeared. It takes no red on any of the three, per the law that already governed frames which did not exist

slide 4's dek was an ordinance citation welded out of two claims that nothing joins. c16's quote gives Ordinance No. 2026-27 and c2's gives August 11th, and no fetched record puts that number on that date. The dek is now the election date, which both c2 and c12 quote

the closing frame's eyebrow read 'where it gets decided' over a bare OPEN MEETING. The sentences stayed inside c16's fence and the LAYOUT did not, which is a verdict delivered by composition and no gate can see it. The label is now the shipped 'NEXT COUNCIL MEETING'. The panels that followed found 'regular' was in c18's text and not its quote, which is the feed-a-field defect in the deck's one reserved colour, so it dropped one step further to the wording c18's own event record supports

the perforation was drawn as hairline ARCS, a near-white stroke on cream and a dark stroke against a dark hole. Both were invisible and the ledger had recorded them as shipped. Redrawn as filled bodies stacked in light order

every
in the deck now carries a space before it. Without one the two words close up in textContent, which is what every gate reads, and slide 2's 'Read the first seven words.' was invisible to aggregate_check for the whole run as 'Read the firstseven words.'

entries.written_from: render/render_report.json, render/machine_qa.json and the gates' own exit codes, never from the storyboard. The plan changed five times during the render loop and the storyboard was reconciled to the frames afterwards, so the plan is a record of what was intended and this is a record of what ran.
entries.register: a Texas road at night in returned light, with one noon inversion. Retroreflective return is the deck's physical law and it carries the argument for free: a mark returns light when the record holds it, and the one mount that carries nothing returns nothing
techniques: an axonometric instrument authored directly in SVG, mounted on a roof plane with thickness through a drawn pedestal casting an occlusion shadow on the sheet metal
a broken time scale, two lanes both linear in elapsed days at different rates, with a filled wedge whose top edge spans exactly the segment the lower lane redraws
a lit caliche haze band with the rig standing in it in silhouette, the air lit rather than the vehicle
an SVG tally of 1,400 marks in 280 groups of five, asserted at build time, under one emitter falloff computed per group index
four parallax planes and a crossing in pure CSS with no raster context on the frame at all
a single class county choropleth through TXGeo's Albers, lit on the seams by a raking sodium lamp so 254 identical fills do not read as a bed
a one point perspective road with the centre line's dashes placed by GROUND DISTANCE and projected, and retroreflective return kept as a separate term from diffuse ambient

a glyph mask driving corduroy striations INSIDE the letterforms with a lit offset edge, on pavement that stayed unmilled. WHAT SHIPPED, not what was planned. The plan was a milled band with the shadow on the near wall and the light on the far one so the type read as cut into the shoulder, and the sixth panel's craft judge measured the pavement behind the glyphs at the same value as the shoulder above and below it, so there is no band and no trough. The type reads as raised on the road rather than cut into it, which is the inverse of the technique, and the offset edge reads as misregistration. This line said the planned thing until that judge read the render and found the ledger had recorded a drawing nobody made, which is the one failure this file exists to make impossible
an SVG guide sign panel with its plate measured from the laid out legend

entries.red_note: Spent once, on the closing frame, on the date block carrying August 25th, 2026 in white mono on the sign panel's green field. It is the deck's only dated public event and the only thing on any frame a reader can put in a calendar.
entries.camera: eight cameras and one register stamp naming each. The middle footer cell used to print FRAME WIDTH in feet and it was a typed numeral that contradicted its own drawing on at least two frames, so it now names how the frame is DRAWN and asserts no quantity
entries.cut: Nothing was cut. Two frames were REBUILT from the ground up after the pixel critics, slide 2 because a hook promising seven marks showed six at feed size, and slide 7 because its haze wedge had its apex on its own subject and its three stripes were painted out at full opacity by two band wells the frame drew over itself.
structural_laws: returned light means the record holds it. The one mount carrying no date returns nothing and takes one rim of the lamp, and it is the darkest area in its lane
no numeral is typed. The first panel found three that were, on three frames, and each one is now interpolated from the code that computes it

no county is named anywhere, because no claim in this run names one and the committed gazetteer holds counties and metros but no cities, so Houston does not resolve to Harris from data this repo holds
no coordinate is printed. Three shipped in the first render and two of the three were wrong against the gazetteer's own computed centroids

every word on a frame is DOM text, and this deck BROKE IT on slide 8. A date on a chart is copy, and canvas fillText ships it as a bitmap that copy_sync, the vector PDF and a screen reader all miss. Slide 2's twelve raster labels were moved to the DOM when the first panel found them, and slide 8's four header strings were not, so the one frame whose entire subject is a machine readable header row ships that row as four bitmaps. machine_qa warns about it four times in the same file this entry says it was written from, and the law sat here stated and broken for three panels before the seventh read the warnings against the law and said so
a container's edge is not its content's edge. Three frames shipped a paragraph, a stripe or a tally row cut by a plate before this was written down

entries.written_from: render/render_report.json, render/machine_qa.json and the gates' own exit codes, never from the storyboard. The storyboard was amended twice during the render loop to follow the frames rather than the reverse, and both amendments are recorded in the run record.
entries.register: the Houston flight control room read as a working object, because a docket index and a status board are the same thing, a fixed set of positions each carrying a name and a short code with a clock running on all of them. The register earns the story's hardest constraint for free: a board never speculates about who is in the chair, which is exactly what the filing index does not publish.

entries.cut: Nothing was cut. Slides 4 and 5 were REBUILT after the pixel critics, slide 4 because the dossier declared five columns and the frame drew two so the item type read as part of the party name, and slide 5 because its two voids carried drop shadows and so read as tiles sitting ON the record rather than as holes cut in it, which inverts the frame's entire argument.
structural_laws: legible means quoted. a block carrying a readable string is a row claims.json quotes, and absence of light never means absence of a filing
every figure is set in JetBrains Mono and never in Fraunces, because FIELD_NOTES records Fraunces rendering 3 as 5 at feed size and this deck's figures are 34, 75, 25.521 and 58482
no cartography and no coordinate. the story names no place
COM, PC, PFP and OPDM appear only as literal strings
no frame applies any noun to a party except the words in the party field
